name: SA_AllocObject
returns: int: new object id, 0 on failure
summary: Creates a new, unplaced object of the given class and subtype and returns its id.
semantics: Type key = (class << 16) | subtype. Original: if the raw class argument == 1 (Space) a Sector-sized object (0x180 bytes, Sector constructor) is built with that key and NO range check; otherwise cls = key>>16 & 0xff and the subtype (key & 0xffff) must be < g_TypeCounts[cls], else 0; a plain Object (0x130) is allocated and Object::Construct(key) builds its class payload. The object is registered in the world id hash but has no parent: it is not in any sector until SA_StartObjectInSpace / SA_StartInHangar etc. The script owns it: free it with SA_FreeObject, or SA_CleanUpObjects kills every still-unplaced non-sector object. Allocation failure -> 0. Cut-scene spaces (class 1 with subtype != 0, Camera.kc) are created this way. Many natives (SA_FindNearestEnemy, SA_IsSafePos, ...) crashed on such an unplaced object in the original (B125/B128). Sync.
x3_src: differs: B118 (Space path chosen by the key's class byte; a Space key spelled differently, e.g. (0x101,0) or (0,0x10000), answers 0; non-Space subtypes range-checked; class >= 0x20 -> 0); B216 (cut-scene space reports its start to the sound system, not in the original)
bugs: AP 0x00460681 (B118): Space path tested on the raw class argument, class taken from the key's second byte: (0x101,0) or (0,0x10000) builds a plain 0x130 Object of class Space that the sector natives then write past (heap corruption); class 1 with subtype bits above 0xffff builds a Sector-sized object of another class with an unchecked subtype. Fixed in x3_src (B118).
notes: FL: same callees (AllocZeroed, Object::Construct); not instruction-compared.

name: SA_FreeObject
summary: Deletes an object (and its children) immediately.
semantics: object by id (FindByIdInWorld); if found Object::Free(obj, 1): removes it from its parent and the world, notifies references and waiting script tasks (a task waiting on the object's order is woken with 8), frees its scene nodes and payload, recursively its children. The id becomes invalid. Not found -> nothing. Sync.
notes: FL calls the function Object::Destruct (naming in the FL database); same role. Exact teardown order not re-read.

name: SA_FindObject
returns: int: the id if the object exists and is not destroyed, else 0
summary: Checks whether an object id is alive: returns the id or 0.
semantics: Object::FindById(arg0) (global id hash, any world); NULL or flags Destroyed set -> 0; else returns object->id (= arg0). Use as an existence test. Sync.

name: SA_SetEventObject
summary: Links a game object to a script object (id) that receives its events.
semantics: obj found -> if arg2 is an int cell: obj.scriptObjectId = the int; if arg2 is an object cell (KC object reference): obj.scriptObjectId = that script object's id; any other type: no change. SA_GetEventObject reads it back. The engine uses this id to call the script object's event functions (destroyed, docked etc.). Missing object: nothing. Answers 0.

name: SA_GetEventObject
returns: int: the linked script object id, 0 if none
summary: Returns the script object linked to an engine object (set by SA_SetEventObject).
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns scriptLink.scriptObjectId: the KC object that receives this engine object's events. Sync.

name: SA_GetParentObject
returns: int: id of the carrying object, 0 if none
summary: Returns the object that carries this one (its carrier link, e.g. a ship for a mounted laser or the debris carrying a rock).
semantics: object by id; missing or carrier NULL -> 0. Returns object.carrier->id. Note: this is the carrier link, not the scene parent; SA_GetEnvironment returns the parent (sector/container). Sync.

name: SA_StartObjectInSpace
summary: Places an object (allocated or removed earlier) into a sector's space.
semantics: obj = Object::FindByIdInWorld(arg1); sector = Sector::FindById(arg2) (a sector id, the Space object id as SA_GetEnvironment returns). If both are found: Sector::AddObject(sector, obj) links obj into the sector's per-class child list and makes it live there (parent = sector). Nothing happens if either is missing. Arguments are raw dwords, types not checked. Always answers int 0 at once. Typical use: SA_AllocObject -> set type/pos -> SA_StartObjectInSpace.

name: SA_KillObject
args: obj:id, reason:int | obj:id, reason:int, killer:id | obj:id, reason:int, killer:id, scriptarg:int|object
summary: Destroys an object (with explosion effects unless the reason is a silent one).
semantics: killer = FindByIdInWorld(arg3) when arg3 is true (CellIsTrue), else none. obj missing -> 0. Object::Destroy((uint16)reason, killer, extra) with extra = arg4 (int) or arg4's script object id (object cell) when argc > 3, else 0. Destroy: once only (flag Destroyed set; a second kill does nothing). Reasons 0xe and 0x10..0x15 are silent (no effects); other reasons stop rotation (and speed for a NoHull bullet-like object) and, if the parent is a sector, spawn the destroy effect and the destroyed sound (in the active sector). A launched missile with a blast radius applies blast damage in its sector. Dependent objects are notified and the object is removed/freed by the world afterwards; its id stops resolving. Answers 0 at once.
x3_src: differs: B136 - the killer cell arg3 is read only when argc > 2
bugs: AP case 7 (0x0046342b): CellIsTrue(arg3) and FindByIdInWorld(arg3) also when argc == 2 - reads the stack cell after the last argument (a stale value may become the killer). Fixed in x3_src (B136). Also Object::Destroy reads parent->objClass for non-silent reasons without a NULL test (an object allocated but never placed would crash) - read only in x3_src, which keeps it.
notes: Destroy internals after the blast branch (notifyRemoved, script events) not fully read.

name: SA_DamageObject
summary: Applies shield and hull damage to an object as if hit by an attacker.
semantics: target and attacker by id; if either is missing nothing happens. Ship::ApplyDamage(target, attacker, shieldDamage, hullDamage): for ships, sectors, gates and objects with flag bit 20 the shield damage is absorbed by the installed Shield children in order (charge reduced proportionally to the shield strength); unabsorbed shield damage plus the hull damage reduce the hull; hits are reported (attacked events, relation, destruction when hull reaches 0). The attacker must exist (pass a real object, e.g. the target itself, for anonymous damage). Sync.
notes: Damage accounting details inside Ship::ApplyDamage (overflow of shield damage into hull, kill path) only skimmed.

name: SA_FlyObjectIntoContainer
returns: int: order result when docking ends (1 docked); 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a ship to dock at a container's port (or fly into a gate) and waits until it has docked.
semantics: ship (class Ship) and container by id else 0. path = arg3 if argc > 3 else -1. Resets requestedPortIndex/portIndex = -1, previousDockingAxis = 0. No GateBypass flag on the container: orderPoint = startPoint = container position. Warpgate: capital ships fly to the gate centre; others to the gate's pass point turned randomly up to 1/8 turn about the gate's z axis. Otherwise if port < 0 or the type has no dock ports: fallback entry point (passVecA * radius, world) for ships/stations. With a port: container must be ship or station class and port < its port count (else 0 at once); Dock::ChoosePortNodeForShipType(ship subtype, cont, port record, path) (NULL -> 0); orderPoint = port node world position, startPoint = 0.7 of the way from the port to its approach point; requestedPortIndex = port, portIndex = path. Then order = 5 (FlyIntoContainer), orderTarget = container. The order approaches, moves the ship kinematically through the docking zone and ends with result 1 on arrival; the task waits (8 ship removed, SA_StopObject value otherwise).
x3_src: differs: B115 (fallback entry point only for ship/station containers; others answer 0)
bugs: AP (B115): fallback docking point read PortContainerData::passVecA of any GateBypass container class: read past payload / crash; fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_FlyObjectBeforeContainer
returns: int: order result when the ship arrives; 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a ship to fly to a point in front of a container (its port approach or exit point), waiting until it arrives.
semantics: ship (class Ship) and container by id else 0. path = arg3 if argc > 3 else -1. requestedPortIndex = -1. If the container lacks the GateBypass flag: orderPoint = container position. Else if port >= 0 and the container type has dock ports: Dock::GetPortApproachPoint(port, cont, ship, path) (failure -> 0 at once), orderPoint = that point in the container's local frame, requestedPortIndex = port, portIndex = path. Else: orderPoint = the container's exit point (passVecB for ships/stations, secondary pass point for gates) * radius, in the world. Then order = 4 (FlyBeforeContainer), orderTarget = container, nextThinkTime = now. The order flies there, detouring around the container and slowing near it; the task waits and is resumed with the result (1 arrival; 8 ship removed; SA_StopObject value).
x3_src: differs: B120 (port upper bound), B121 (a GateBypass container that is not a ship, station or gate answers 0)
bugs: AP 0x00460dd5 (B121): GateBypass container of any class reads PortContainerData::passVecB past its payload (crash for classes without a block); AP (B120) port has no upper bound in GetPortApproachPoint. Fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_IsObjectBeforeContainer
summary: Tells whether a ship is lined up in front of a container's dock port (close enough and facing it).
semantics: 0 unless: ship and container found, ship is class Ship, container has flag GateBypass (stations/carriers), 0 <= port < the container type's port count. Port node = Dock::ChoosePortNodeForShipType(ship's class code, container, port record, -1); none -> 0. Approach data from Dock::ComputePortApproachPoint (approach direction in the port frame and the max approach distance). Answer 1 only if all hold: the approach direction (rotated to world) dotted with the ship's forward axis <= -0.92 (ship flies against the approach vector, within about 23 degrees), the distance ship-port <= max approach distance, and the ship's forward axis points at the port within the same 0.92 cosine; else 0. Answers at once.
notes: FL inlines ChoosePortNodeForShipType (passes TShips row+0x14 class code to Dock::ChoosePortNode). Port records read at the container payload's port array for Ship and other classes alike.

name: SA_FlyObjectBeforeContainerPos
returns: int: order result when the ship arrives; 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a ship to fly to a given point relative to a container, waiting until it arrives.
semantics: ship (class Ship) and container by id else 0. orderPoint = (arg2, arg3, arg4) (engine units), order = 4 (FlyBeforeContainer), orderTarget = container, requestedPortIndex = -1 (so the point is used as a world point, not relative to the container frame). nextThinkTime is NOT reset (unlike most order natives). The task waits; resumed with the order result (1 arrival, 8 ship removed, SA_StopObject value).
notes: Order 4 treats orderPoint as container-relative only when requestedPortIndex >= 0 (sector.cpp comment); here it is -1.

name: SA_ClearObjectFromHangar
returns: int: order result when the ship has left; 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a docked/launched ship to leave a container's hangar (undock) and waits until it is clear.
semantics: ship by id must be class Ship, container by id must exist and be class Ship, Factory, Dock or Warpgate; otherwise 0 at once. nextThinkTime = now, order = 0x1e (LeaveHangar), orderTarget = container, startPoint = ship position, requestedPortIndex = arg2; if port >= 0 the port's approach point (Dock::GetPortApproachPoint, 2220 m further out) is written to orderPoint. The order (sector.cpp 0x1e) pulls the ship out of the gate/port/station; the task waits and is resumed with the order result (1 when clear; 8 ship removed; SA_StopObject value).
x3_src: differs: B120 (getPortApproachPoint bounds the port and class; a port beyond the container's ports gives no approach point instead of a wild read)
bugs: AP 0x00461236 (B120): port only checked >= 0, GetPortApproachPoint indexes the port table without an upper bound and treats any non-Ship container (a Warpgate) as DockData: wild read; fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_WarpObjectAway
returns: int (result delivered when the warp-out order ends; 0 at once on a bad ship)
summary: Orders a ship to warp out (optionally through a jump gate); the task waits until the order completes.
semantics: gate = FindByIdInWorld(arg2) if arg2 non-zero. Ship missing or not class Ship -> answers 0 at once. Else: order = WarpAway, scriptLock = -1, orderDeadline = game time + 900 ms, orderPoint = current position; if gate is a Warpgate: gate flags |= GateTransitRequest and ship flags |= ScriptWarpEffect (gate jump effect), else no gate; orderTarget = gate (or NULL). The calling task is suspended: the ship's wait link (group slot, task id) is set, and the task is resumed by Script::WakeTaskWithResult when the ship AI finishes the order (or by SA_StopObject with its result). The call site is a savegame return point.
notes: Result value set by the WarpAway order code was not traced.

name: SA_AvoidObjectCollision
returns: int: order result when the avoidance ends; 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a ship into collision-avoidance flight and waits until the avoidance order ends.
semantics: ship by id, must be class Ship else 0 at once. nextThinkTime = now; order = 0x12 (AvoidCollision); orderArg (avoid level) = rand*10/0x8000 + 1 (1..10) if argc > 2 and arg2 is non-zero, else 0; startPoint = current position; orderRadius = arg1, or ship radius + 300 m when arg1 <= 0; rollDrift = 0, speedLimit = -1 (none); orderPoint = position + 5*radius along the ship's z (forward) axis. The order every 200 ms reads the collision warning list (up to 5 obstacles filled by the collision pass) and picks evasion directions. The task waits until the order completes (WakeTaskWithResult: order result, 8 if the ship is removed, SA_StopObject value).
bugs: bugs.md (Sector::SimulateObjects, agent F, unverified): order 0x12 compares FixMul(closing,closing) (16.16) with float 1-f^2 (0x00456e89-0x00456eb4) so evasion triggers almost always; x3_src reproduces.

name: SA_CaptureObject
returns: int: order result when the order ends; 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a ship to fly to and capture (pick up) a target object, waiting until the order ends.
semantics: ship and target by id; either missing or ship not class Ship -> 0 at once. order = 0x18 (CaptureTarget), orderTarget = target, nextThinkTime = now, timeout enabled if arg2 > 0 (timeoutTime = now + arg2). The task waits (scriptLink) and is resumed with the order result: 13 on timeout, 8 if the ship is removed, the SA_StopObject value, or the order's own completion value (shared code of orders 0x10/0x11/0x18).

name: SA_AttackObject
returns: int: order result when the order ends (see semantics); 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a ship to attack a target object (small-target attack order) and waits until the order ends.
semantics: ship and target by id (FindByIdInWorld); either missing or ship not class Ship -> answers 0 at once. Sets ShipData order = 0x10 (AttackTarget), orderTarget = target; reach = subtreeRadius(target) + subtreeRadius(ship), capped at 200 m (100000 units); orderPoint = a random point on the circle of radius reach (angle = rand(1000)/1000 turn) in the target's frame, z 0; nextThinkTime = now; orderActionTimeMs = now + arg2 if arg2 > 0, else now + 50 ms; timeout enabled if arg3 > 0 (timeoutTime = now + arg3). Then the ship's scriptLink (waitModuleSlot = SA group, waitTaskId = caller) is set and the dispatcher returns without answering: the task waits. The ship's order processing (Sector::SimulateObjects orders 0x10/0x11/0x18) resumes it via Script::WakeTaskWithResult: 13 (0xd) when the timeout elapses, 8 when the ship is destroyed/removed, the SA_StopObject value when stopped, other values from the order code (target lost etc.). A newer order native on the same ship overwrites the wait link without waking the first task (that task then never resumes unless the ship is freed). Lengths in engine units (1/500 m), times in ms.
notes: FL uses _rand directly instead of Util::RandomInt; same flow by callees. Exact completion results of order 0x10 not enumerated here (sector.cpp updateAttackOrder).

name: SA_AttackObjectBig
returns: int: order result when the order ends; 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a ship to attack a large target (capital ship/station attack order) and waits until the order ends.
semantics: Identical to SA_AttackObject except order = 0x11 (AttackLargeTarget): ship/target by id, ship must be class Ship else 0 at once; reach = subtreeRadius(ship)+subtreeRadius(target) capped at 200 m; random orbit point on that circle; orderActionTimeMs = now + arg2 (arg2 > 0) else now + 50 ms; timeout if arg3 > 0. The task waits until the order ends (result 13 timeout, 8 ship removed, SA_StopObject value, or the order's own result).

name: SA_DefensiveMove
returns: int: order result when the order ends; 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a ship into random evasive manoeuvres (away from an attacker) for a time, waiting until done.
semantics: ship by id must be class Ship else 0. arg4 non-zero -> attacker by id (may be missing -> none). arg1 is not read. orderRadius = arg2, order = 0x22 (DefensiveMove), orderTarget = attacker, nextThinkTime = now, orderArg = 0, orderActionTimeMs = now; timeout always enabled: now + arg3, or 300000 ms (5 min) when arg3 <= 0. The order picks a new random evasion point (not towards the attacker) and steering style every action interval. The task waits; resumed with 13 when the timeout elapses (normal end), 8 if the ship is removed, or the SA_StopObject value.

name: SA_EscortObject
args: ship:int, leader:int, x:int, y:int, z:int, tolerance:int, timeoutMs:int
returns: int: order result when the order ends; 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a ship to hold a formation slot relative to a leader object, waiting until the order ends.
semantics: ship (class Ship) and leader by id, else 0 at once. order = 0x14 (EscortTarget), orderTarget = leader, orderPoint = (arg2, arg3, arg4) = the slot in the leader's frame (AnglesToMatrix(leader alpha, beta, 0)), orderRadius = arg5 slot tolerance, nextThinkTime = now, timeout if arg6 > 0. The order keeps the slot and matches formation speed indefinitely; the task waits until timeout (13), ship removal (8), SA_StopObject, or the order ends itself (leader lost).

name: SA_StopObjectTurret
summary: Stops a ship turret's script order and wakes the task waiting on that turret.
semantics: Object found, class Ship, 0 < turret < GetGunGroupCount(ship) (turret 0, the main cockpit, is excluded) -> turrets[turret]: target = 0, both callback times = 0; Ship::FireTurretScriptCallback(ship, turret, arg3): if a task waits on this turret (SA_TurretTurnToObject etc.), its group's callback resumes it with arg3 and the turret's wait link is cleared. Else nothing. Answers 0 at once.

name: SA_TurnToObject
returns: int (order result; 0 at once on bad arguments)
summary: Orders a ship to turn to face an object; the task waits until the order ends.
semantics: Ship or target missing, or ship not class Ship -> 0 at once. orderRadius = arg3 if argc >= 3 else 400000 (raw length, 800 m); order = TurnToTarget; orderTarget = target; ship wait link = (group, task); task suspended until the order code wakes it (WakeTaskWithResult) or SA_StopObject. Savegame return point.
notes: Meaning of orderRadius for this order (tolerance/stop distance) not traced.

name: SA_TurretTurnToObject
returns: int (turret callback result; 0 at once on bad arguments)
summary: Turns a ship turret to track an object; the task waits until the turret reports (aimed or timed out).
semantics: Answers 0 at once when: ship or target missing, ship not class Ship, turret <= 0 or >= GetGunGroupCount(ship) (turret 0 = main cockpit is not allowed), tmin <= 0 or tmax < tmin. Else turrets[turret]: wait link = (native group, calling task id), mode = TargetObject, target = target, earliest callback = now + tmin ms, deadline = now + tmax ms; the task is suspended. The turret update calls Ship::FireTurretScriptCallback with its result (on aim/deadline), and SA_StopObjectTurret delivers its own result. A second call on the same turret overwrites the link (the first waiting task is never resumed). Savegame return point.
notes: Result codes produced by the turret update not traced.

name: SA_TurretTurnToPosition
returns: int (turret callback result; 0 at once on bad arguments)
summary: Turns a ship turret towards a direction/position given in the ship's frame; the task waits until the turret reports.
semantics: pos elements 0..2 read with ArrayGetElement. Answers 0 at once when: ship missing or not a Ship, turret <= 0 or >= gun group count, tmin <= 0 or tmax < tmin. Else turrets[turret]: wait link = (group, task), target = NULL, mode = TargetLocalDirection, targetPos = (pos[0], pos[1], pos[2], 0), earliest = now + tmin ms, deadline = now + tmax ms; task suspended until FireTurretScriptCallback / SA_StopObjectTurret. Savegame return point.
x3_src: differs: B124 - a non-array or < 3 elements answers 0
bugs: AP 0x00461c46: the array elements are dereferenced before any test - a non-array or short array crashes (read at address 1). Fixed in x3_src (B124).

name: SA_StartInHangar
summary: Puts a ship into a carrier/station: at a dock port, at the arrival point in space, or stored inside.
semantics: ship or carrier missing -> 0. port = arg3 if argc >= 3 else -1. Ship::StartInHangarCore(ship, carrier, port): for a Ship it stores requestedPortIndex = port and resets the flight mode; moves the object into the carrier's lists; carrier not Ship/Dock/Factory -> the object is just stored (flag StoredInContainer) -> result 1; port < 0 -> placed at the carrier's arrival point in the carrier's sector, angles re-derived, added to the sector -> result 2; port >= the carrier type's port count or unusable -> -1; else attached at that port (Dock::AttachShipToPort) -> 2; transfer failure -> 0. Handler: -1 -> answer 0; 0 -> answer 10; 2 -> answer 1; 1 -> the task WAITS (wait link set on the ship, woken by WakeTaskWithResult later, e.g. SA_StopObject). Savegame return point in that case.
x3_src: differs: B116 - non-ship objects: no ShipData write (nextThinkTime, port index) and the M5 slot type for the port choice
bugs: AP 0x004626e2 -> Ship::StartInHangarCore 0x00443920: any object class accepted; writes ShipData::nextThinkTime (+0x210) of a non-ship (past a small payload) and, with a port, reads shipRows()[subtype] by a non-ship's subtype. Fixed in x3_src (B116).
notes: Result-code names come from x3_src (HangarPlacementResult); what wakes the stored-in-container wait not traced.

name: SA_Idle
returns: int (order result; 0 at once for a non-ship)
summary: Lets a ship wander around its current position for a time; the task waits until the time is up.
semantics: Ship missing or not class Ship -> 0 at once. order = Wander, orderPoint = current position, nextThinkTime = now, timeoutTime = now + arg2 (ms of game time); wait link set; task suspended until the order times out (or SA_StopObject). Savegame return point.

name: SA_FollowObject
returns: int: order result (1 when within distance); 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Orders a ship to follow a target until it is within a given distance, waiting until the order ends.
semantics: ship (class Ship) and target by id, else 0 at once. order = 0x15 (FollowTarget), orderTarget = target, orderRadius = arg2 (engine units), nextThinkTime = now, timeout if arg3 > 0. The order chases the target and completes with 1 once within orderRadius; 13 on timeout, 8 if the ship is removed, SA_StopObject value. The task waits.
bugs: bugs.md (agent F, medium, unverified): order 0x15 uses the target's world position instead of the ship->target vector in its lead test (0x00458bd4-0x00458cc2); x3_src reproduces.

name: SA_FollowObjectByCut
returns: int: order result; 0 at once on bad arguments
summary: Places/moves a ship along a cut-scene path anchored at a target object, waiting until the order ends.
semantics: ship (class Ship) and target by id, else 0. order = 0x16 (FollowByCut), orderTarget = target, orderRadius = arg2 (used as the cut id, not a length), orderArg = arg3 (the cut node id), nextThinkTime = now + rand*1000/0x8000 ms (0..999 ms random start delay). No timeout. The order animates the ship by the cut anchored at the target; the task waits until the order ends (8 ship removed, SA_StopObject value, or the order's completion).
bugs: bugs.md (agent F, unverified): order 0x16 reads [0+4] when LoadCutScene fails (0x00458ea2 / 0x00458f2b): a bad cut id crashes; x3_src reproduces.

name: SA_RotateToAngles
args: ship:id, a:int, b:int | ship:id, a:int, b:int, c:int
returns: int (order result; 0 at once for a non-ship)
summary: Orders a ship to rotate to given angles; the task waits until done.
semantics: Ship missing or not class Ship -> 0 at once. order = RotateToAngles; order angles 0 and 1 = arg2, arg3 (1/65536 turn); with argc <= 3 the third (roll) is the sentinel INT32_MIN = any roll; else arg4 wrapped into [0, 1 turn). Wait link set; task suspended until the order code wakes it or SA_StopObject. Savegame return point.

name: SA_MovePos
returns: int (order result; 0 at once for a non-ship)
summary: Orders a ship to fly to a position; the task waits until it arrives (within radius) or the order is stopped.
semantics: Ship missing or not class Ship -> 0 at once. order = MoveToPosition, orderRadius = arg5 (arrival tolerance), orderPoint = (x, y, z) in the parent's frame; wait link set; task suspended until the order code wakes it or SA_StopObject(ship, result). Savegame return point.

name: SA_MovePosContinue
returns: int (order result; 0 at once for a non-ship)
summary: As SA_MovePos but keeps speed through the point (waypoint chaining).
semantics: Same as SA_MovePos with order = ContinueMove (the ship does not brake for the point, so successive calls make a smooth path). Ship missing / non-ship -> 0 at once; otherwise the task waits. Savegame return point.

name: SA_GlidePos
args: ship:id, x:int, y:int, z:int, tolerance:int, speed:int
returns: int (order result; 0 at once for a non-ship)
summary: Orders a ship to glide (strafe without turning) to a position; the task waits until it arrives.
semantics: Ship missing or not class Ship -> 0 at once. order = GlideToPosition, orderPoint = (x, y, z), pending turn zeroed, orderRadius packs (arg6/222) << 16 | (arg5/222 & 0xffff) (glide speed and tolerance in units of 222); wait link set; task suspended until the order code wakes it or SA_StopObject. Savegame return point.
notes: Which of arg5/arg6 is speed vs tolerance is from x3_src names (setGlide(b = arg6, a = arg5)).

name: SA_WarpObjectIn
returns: int (order result; 0 at once for a non-ship)
summary: Orders a ship to warp in (optionally out of a jump gate); the task waits until the arrival ends.
semantics: gate = FindByIdInWorld(arg2) if non-zero. Ship missing or not class Ship -> 0 at once. Unless the ship already has order WarpIn with the same target: order = WarpIn, scriptLock = 1, orderDeadline = now + 900 ms, orderPoint = current position; if gate is a Warpgate: ship flags |= ScriptWarpEffect and the ship is moved 2697.3 m (1665000*810000/1000000 raw) along the gate's z axis from its position; else no gate; orderTarget = gate. In all cases the wait link is set and the task waits until the WarpIn order ends (or SA_StopObject, which also puts the ship at orderPoint). Savegame return point.

name: SA_GetMainType
summary: Returns an object's class (main type), e.g. 1 sector, 5 dock, 6 factory, 7 ship.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns objClass (SSTYPE_*): 0 Bullet, 1 Space (sector), 2 Background, 3 Sun, 4 Planet, 5 Dock, 6 Factory, 7 Ship, 8 Laser, 9 Shield, 10 Missile, 11..16 wares (Energy, Natural, Bio, Food, Minerals, Tech), 17 Asteroid, 18 Warpgate, 19 Camera, 20 Special, 21 Nebula, 22 InStation, 23 Dummy, 24 Command, 25 Cockpit, 26 DataType, 27 ExplosionBody, 28 Debris, 29 DockWreck, 30 FactoryWreck, 31 ShipWreck. Note a missing object also answers 0 (= Bullet): test existence with SA_FindObject first. Sync.

name: SA_GetSubType
summary: Returns the object's subtype (row in its class's type table).
semantics: obj found -> (int16)obj.subtype sign-extended; missing object -> 0 (indistinguishable from subtype 0). Answers at once.

name: SA_GetType
summary: Returns the object's type key class<<16 | subtype.
semantics: obj found -> (objClass << 16) | subtype (subtype as signed int16 OR-ed in, so a negative subtype would smear the high word; stock subtypes are >= 0). Missing object -> 0 (same as class 0 Bullet subtype 0). The key is the form SA_MatchType, SA_ObjectTypeFromBody and the type tables use. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetPosX
summary: Returns the x coordinate of an object's position in its sector.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns rootNode->pos[0] (local position in the parent sector, 1/500 m units). Shared handler with SA_GetPosY/Z (index = command - 37). Sync.
x3_src: differs: B126 (object without root node answers 0)
bugs: AP 0x004620ac (B126): sector id dereferences NULL root node (crash); fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_GetPosY
summary: Returns the y coordinate of an object's position in its sector.
semantics: Same handler as SA_GetPosX; returns rootNode->pos[1]. Missing object -> 0. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B126 (object without root node answers 0)
bugs: AP (B126): sector id crashes; fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_GetPosZ
summary: Returns the z coordinate of an object's position in its sector.
semantics: Same handler as SA_GetPosX; returns rootNode->pos[2]. Missing object -> 0. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B126 (object without root node answers 0)
bugs: AP (B126): sector id crashes; fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_SetPos
summary: Sets an object's position inside its parent (engine units).
semantics: obj = FindByIdInWorld(arg1); if found, Object::SetPosition(obj, x, y, z): nothing if the object has no scene node (a sector); otherwise writes rootNode pos and worldPos (with a detail-switch update around it when the object has a parent and flags2 DetailSwitch). Side effects by class: Sun - its light and glow nodes follow and the parent sector's background rotation (gamma, time) resets to 0; Planet - background rotation reset and the planet light is placed at 10x the planet position, or at 2,000,000 units along the same direction when any coordinate exceeds 200,000. No collision test (see SA_SetSafePos). Values in the same raw units SA_GetPosX/Y/Z return. Answers 0 at once.

name: SA_SetSafePos
args: obj:id | obj:id, near:id | obj:id, x:int, y:int, z:int
summary: Puts an object at a collision-free position (random near a reference, or near given coordinates).
semantics: obj missing -> 0. argc == 4: Ship::FindFreeArrivalOffset(obj, x, y, z): places the node at (x,y,z); if it overlaps something, up to 20 random tries at growing distances (scale (radius*3...)*1..16, radius doubled per try) until free (gives up silently, leaving the last try). argc == 2: ref = FindByIdInWorld(arg2) if arg2 is true (CellIsTrue), else none. Any other argc (and argc 2): Ship::PlaceAtRandomArrivalOffset(obj, ref): up to 20 tries of a random direction at a random distance 0..63/64 of (radii sum + 200 m), growing 1.5x per try (with ref: + 3x the radii sum, relative to ref's position); stops at the first non-overlapping spot. Without ref the random spot is around the origin of the parent. Answers 0.
x3_src: differs: B126 - an object without a scene node (sector) is ignored
bugs: AP 0x00462c03: obj->rootNode used by both helpers without a test - a sector id crashes. Fixed in x3_src (B126).

name: SA_GetSafePos
returns: array[3]: a collision-free position near (x,y,z), or int 0
summary: Finds a collision-free position for an object near a wanted point, without moving it.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Saves the root node position, calls Ship::FindFreeArrivalOffset(obj, x, y, z): puts the object at (x,y,z) and, if it overlaps something, tries up to 20 randomised offsets (search radius from the object radius, growing up to 16x, 20 m direction span) for a free spot; reads the resulting position into a new 3-element array, then restores the original position. The task gets the array. The random retries use the game RNG. Sync.
bugs: AP 0x00462c98: rootNode (obj+0x70) read without a NULL check: a sector id (no root node) crashes. Not in bugs.md (B126 covers SA_SetSafePos but not SA_GetSafePos); x3_src reproduces (sa_dispatcher.cpp:4371).
notes: Overlap test details (resolveArrivalOverlap) not read; it may also need the object's parent sector (unplaced objects untested).

name: SA_SetRelativePos
summary: Places an object at an offset given in another object's frame.
semantics: Both found -> obj.rootNode.pos = (ox,oy,oz) * ref.rootNode.rot + ref.rootNode.pos (w = 0). Raw node write: worldPos, detail switch and sun/planet side effects of SA_SetPos are NOT done; both objects should share a parent. Missing either -> nothing. Answers 0.
x3_src: differs: B126 - objects without a scene node are ignored
bugs: AP 0x00462d5f: root nodes not tested - a sector id crashes. Fixed in x3_src (B126).

name: SA_GetRotAlpha
returns: int: alpha (yaw) angle, script angle units
summary: Returns an object's alpha rotation angle.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns motion.rotAlpha (the stored Euler angle the engine builds the rotation from; set by SA_SetRot). Sync.

name: SA_GetRotBeta
summary: Returns an object's beta rotation angle.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns motion.rotBeta. Sync.

name: SA_GetRotGamma
summary: Returns an object's gamma rotation angle.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns motion.rotGamma. Sync.

name: SA_GetRotationMatrix
returns: array[3] of array[3] (rows of the rotation matrix, fixed point), or int 0
summary: Returns an object's 3x3 rotation matrix as an array of three row arrays.
semantics: object by id; missing or no root node -> 0 (AP checks obj+0x70). Else a new 3-array; each element a new 3-array: [row][col] = rootNode rotation (row 2 = forward axis), fixed-point ratio. The task gets the outer array. Sync.

name: SA_SetRot
summary: Sets an object's Euler angles (1/65536 turn) and rebuilds its rotation matrix.
semantics: obj found -> Object::SetAngles(obj, alpha, beta, gamma): stores motion.rotAlpha/Beta/Gamma (the values SA_GetRotAlpha/Beta/Gamma read back), and if the object has a scene node rebuilds rootNode rot and worldRot from the three angles (detail-switch update around it when parented with DetailSwitch); a Sun's light and glow nodes take the same rotation. Angles are 1/65536 of a full turn, not wrapped here. Missing object: nothing. Answers 0.

name: SA_GetDirX
returns: int: x of the forward axis (16.16 fixed, 0x10000 = 1.0)
summary: Returns the x component of an object's forward (z) axis.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns rootNode rotation row 2 (the forward axis) element 0 as a fixed-point ratio. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B126 (object without root node answers 0)
bugs: AP (B126): sector id crashes on NULL root node; fixed in x3_src.
notes: Ratio script unit assumed 16.16; not re-read.

name: SA_GetDirY
returns: int: y of the forward axis (fixed point)
summary: Returns the y component of an object's forward (z) axis.
semantics: As SA_GetDirX, element 1 of rotation row 2. Missing object -> 0. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B126 (object without root node answers 0)
bugs: AP (B126): sector id crashes; fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_GetDirZ
returns: int: z of the forward axis (fixed point)
summary: Returns the z component of an object's forward (z) axis.
semantics: As SA_GetDirX, element 2 of rotation row 2. Missing object -> 0. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B126 (object without root node answers 0)
bugs: AP (B126): sector id crashes; fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_SetDirection
summary: Turns an object to face a direction vector.
semantics: obj found -> Object::SetOrientationFromDirection with the direction (arg2, arg3, arg4) in engine axes (the handler passes them rotated, the callee un-rotates: forward = normalize(arg2, arg3, arg4)). Zero vector: nothing. up = (0,1,0), or (0,0,-1) when |forward.y| > 0.95; right = up x forward, up = forward x right, both normalized; the matrix is converted to Euler angles and applied with Object::SetAngles (so rotAlpha/Beta/Gamma are updated too). Answers 0.

name: SA_GetBody
returns: int: body id of the object's root node, -1 if missing
summary: Returns the body (model) id of an object's root scene node.
semantics: object by id; missing -> -1. Else rootNode->bodyId. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B126 (object without root node, i.e. a sector, answers -1)
bugs: AP (B126): a sector id dereferences the NULL root node; fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_GetCompBody
returns: int: the type's second (component/cockpit) body id, or the root node body; -1 on failure
summary: Returns an object's type 'component' body id (second body), falling back to its root node body.
semantics: object by id; missing -> -1. Object::IsValidTypeIndex(class, subtype) false -> -1. body = type header(class, subtype).bodyId2; if 0, the object's rootNode->bodyId. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B126 (fallback with no root node answers -1)
bugs: AP (B126): with bodyId2 == 0 and an object without root node the NULL node is read; fixed in x3_src.
notes: FL uses FUN_0046a610 for the type-index check.

name: SA_GetCutID
returns: int: the object's scene/cut id, 0 if none
summary: Returns the cut-scene (scene) id of a container object.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0; object without child lists (not a container: Object::HasChildLists false) -> 0. Else object.sceneId (the cut/scene id its model was built from). Sync.

name: SA_GetObjectTextID
returns: int: name text id of the object's type
summary: Returns the text id of an object's type name.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Object::GetObjectTextId: if the class has a type table -> header(class, subtype).nameTextId; a sector (no table) -> 0x372; other classes without a table -> 0. Sync.

name: SA_GetSize
summary: Returns the size (radius) of the object's root scene node.
semantics: obj found -> rootNode.size (engine length units, raw). Missing object -> 0. The value is the root node's own size, not including child parts (SA_GetTotalSize is the subtree radius). Answers at once.
x3_src: differs: B126 - an object without a scene node (a sector, class Space) answers 0
bugs: AP 0x00462877: rootNode dereferenced without a NULL test - an object id of a sector (Space object, no scene node) crashes the game. x3_src fixed (B126).

name: SA_GetTotalSize
summary: Returns the bounding radius of the object's whole scene subtree.
semantics: obj found -> Scene::GetSubtreeRadius(rootNode): the radius enclosing the root node and all child parts (engine length units). Missing object -> 0. Answers at once.
x3_src: differs: B126 - an object without a scene node (sector) answers 0
bugs: AP 0x0046289d: rootNode not tested - a sector id crashes. x3_src fixed (B126).

name: SA_GetMass
returns: int: the object's base radius word (the 'mass' slot)
summary: Returns the object's 'mass' value, which the engine stores in its base radius field.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns spatial.radiusBase (engine length units; set by SA_SetMass). The engine has no separate mass: the base radius doubles as it. Sync.
notes: Field identity per x3_src naming (radiusBase); not re-read in the exe.

name: SA_SetMass
summary: Sets the object's base radius field (the field SA_GetMass reads).
semantics: obj found -> spatial.radiusBase = arg2 and the answer is arg2; missing object -> 0. Despite the name the field is the base radius of the spatial block used for collision/approach sizing, not a physical mass. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetSpeed
summary: Returns the object's current speed.
semantics: obj found -> motion.speed (raw engine speed units, the same units SA_SetSpeed and SA_SetDesiredSpeed take). Missing object -> 0. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetMaxSpeed
returns: int: current maximum speed (engine units per s)
summary: Returns an object's current maximum speed including upgrades, damage and slowdowns.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Ship::GetMaxSpeed: base type speed; ships: speedOverride if >= 0, else * (1 + speed bonus), reduced linearly by hull damage (full speed at 90% hull down to 30% at 10%), timed slow effects (an expired one is cleared as a side effect) and container limits. Other classes: their type's base speed. Sync.

name: SA_GetDockingSpeed
returns: int: maximum landing speed (engine units per s)
summary: Returns the maximum docking (landing) speed of a ship: a quarter of its max speed, at least 40 m/s.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Ship::GetMaxLandingSpeed: max(GetMaxSpeed/4, 40 m/s). GetMaxSpeed applies speed override, speed bonus, hull-damage slowdown and timed slow effects for ships; other classes use their type's base speed. Note GetMaxSpeed may clear an expired slowdown as a side effect. Sync.

name: SA_SetSpeed
summary: Sets the object's current speed at once (no acceleration).
semantics: obj found -> motion.speed = arg2, answer 1; missing -> 0. desiredSpeed is unchanged, so the object will accelerate back to it. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetDesiredSpeed
returns: int: desired speed (engine units per s)
summary: Returns an object's desired (target) speed.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns motion.desiredSpeed (any class). Sync.

name: SA_SetDesiredSpeed
summary: Sets the speed the object accelerates/decelerates towards.
semantics: obj found -> if obj is the player ship, clears bit 0x40000 of the input flag block (as SA_SetAutopilot on); motion.desiredSpeed = arg2 (raw speed units, not clamped to max speed here; the motion update limits it). Answer 1; missing object -> 0.

name: SA_SetExtraSpeed
summary: Sets a ship's speed bonus in tenths (engine tuning).
semantics: Object found and class Ship; arg2 <= 999 (JG 0x3e7 rejects larger, answer 0) -> ShipData.speedBonus = (arg2 << 16) / 10 (a 16.16 value of arg2/10). The bonus scales the ship's max speed (SA_GetMaxSpeed). No lower bound in the original. Answers 0.
x3_src: differs: B30 - values below -0x50000 (-327680) are rejected (answer 0, nothing written)
bugs: AP 0x004642b0..0x004642d4 (bugs.md B30): only the upper bound is checked; (arg2<<16)/10 is a 64/32 IDIV whose quotient overflows for arg2 < -327680 -> #DE divide error, the game crashes. FL same code. x3_src rejects such values (B30).

name: SA_GetAcceleration
summary: Returns an object's flight acceleration.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Ship::GetAcceleration: Ship -> type acceleration * (1 + speed bonus); Missile -> missile type acceleration; Camera -> 2000 m/s^2 fixed; other classes 0. Sync.

name: SA_SetRotSpeed
summary: Sets an object's current rotation rates (angle steps per second).
semantics: obj found -> motion.rotRate[0..2] = arg2, arg3, arg4; if all three are 0 the pending turn (turnLeft) is cleared (AP: Object::ClearPendingTurnIfRotStopped when rx == 0 tests the other two). Missing object: nothing. The task is then completed through Script::NativeCompletion(group, 0, task) (the group's done callback resumes it with 0) instead of the dispatcher's usual resume, so the script continues at once with 0.
notes: sync_scan reports 'may wait' because the resume goes through NativeCompletion. FL inlines the rate store into 0x00458f30, which the FL database misnames Object::SetClass1CValue; x3_src object.cpp also gives FL 0x00458f30 as the address of setDebrisDensity, which is wrong (that FL function sets rotation rates).

name: SA_SetGlide
summary: Sets the object's glide (slip) velocity vector.
semantics: obj found -> motion.slipVelocity[0..2] = arg2, arg3, arg4 (raw speed units, in the object's frame as used by the motion update). Sticks until changed; SA_GlidePos also drives it. Answers 0.

name: SA_GetStepX
summary: Returns the ship's current pitch rate limit (angle steps per second).
semantics: obj found -> Ship::GetPitchRate(obj): the ship type's pitch rate (1/65536 turn per second) with the ship's rotation bonus applied (see SA_SetExtraRotSpeed). Missing object -> 0. Reads ship tables by the subtype, intended for class Ship. Answers at once.
notes: GetPitchRate body not re-read for non-ship classes; with a non-ship object the subtype may index the ship table (garbage value).

name: SA_GetStepY
summary: Returns the ship's current yaw rate limit (angle steps per second).
semantics: As SA_GetStepX with Ship::GetYawRate. Missing object -> 0. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetStepZ
summary: Returns the ship's current roll rate limit (angle steps per second).
semantics: As SA_GetStepX with Ship::GetRollRate. Missing object -> 0. Answers at once.

name: SA_SetExtraRotSpeed
summary: Sets a ship's rotation-rate bonus in tenths.
semantics: Object found and class Ship; arg2 <= 0x999 (2457 - hex, unlike SA_SetExtraSpeed's 999; larger -> answer 0) -> ShipData.rotRateBonus (data+0x270) = (arg2 << 16) / 10. The bonus scales pitch/yaw/roll rates (SA_GetStepX/Y/Z). Answers 0.
x3_src: differs: values below -0x50000 are rejected (answer 0); this is the B30 policy, but bugs.md B30 names only SA_SetExtraSpeed
bugs: AP 0x00464314: upper bound 0x999 (2457), probably meant 999 as in SA_SetExtraSpeed; no lower bound and the same 64/32 IDIV: arg2 < -327680 raises #DE (crash). x3_src rejects < -0x50000 but keeps the 0x999 bound; bugs.md B30 does not list this native.

name: SA_GetCount
summary: Returns the quantity (stack count) of an object such as a ware, laser, shield or missile.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Object::GetQuantity: Missile/Laser/Shield -> payload quantity; classes 0xb..0x10 (wares) -> first payload word; Camera -> follow-data quantity; anything else 1. Sync.

name: SA_SetCount
summary: Sets the quantity of a ware/laser/shield/missile object (or a camera's quantity field).
semantics: obj found -> Object::SetQuantity(count): Missile -> MissileData.quantity; Laser -> LaserData.quantity; Shield -> ShieldData.quantity; ware classes 11..16 -> the payload's first dword (the ware amount); Camera -> CameraFollowData.quantity; other classes: nothing. No clamping, negative values are stored. Counterpart of SA_GetCount. Answers 0.

name: SA_SetSubType
summary: Changes an object's subtype (type row in its class table) and rebuilds its model.
semantics: obj found -> obj.subtype = (int16)arg2; unless the object is a Missile, Object::RebuildSceneNode: for every class except Nebula, Camera and Space: allocates the root node if there is none, else releases all its child nodes; sets the node model to the type's bodyId (ExplosionBody: the subtype itself is the model id); if the type has a cut key (GetTypeKeyValue > 0) stores it as the object's sceneId and builds the scene parts. Class, owner, position, hull and equipment are not changed (hull is not re-clamped to the new type). Answers 0.
x3_src: differs: B119 - a subtype outside the class's type table (except ExplosionBody) is ignored (answer 0, nothing stored)
bugs: AP 0x00462299 / FL 0x0046c437: no range check on subtype. RebuildSceneNode at once reads header(class,subtype).bodyId and the cut key beyond the type table, and later natives index shipRows()[subtype] (SA_GetStepX/Y/Z, SA_GetNumCockpits, SA_StopObjectTurret, speeds): garbage values or a crash for a bad subtype. x3_src fixed it (B119).

name: SA_SetLight
summary: Sets the light colour of a sun (light and glow nodes) or a planet.
semantics: obj found -> Object::SetRotationAngles (AP 0x0044fc70; the database name is misleading, it sets colours): Sun - the sun's light node and glow node get lightColor = (int16)r,g,b and are re-attached to their scene so the change applies; Planet - PlanetData colour[0..2] = r,g,b and the planet light node is updated the same way; other classes: nothing. Component range is whatever the renderer uses (0..255 in stock scripts). Answers 0.
notes: Planet branch beyond the colour store read only in x3_src. Ghidra name Object::SetRotationAngles (and x3_src Object::setRotationAngles) is wrong: the function sets light colours.

name: SA_GetShield
summary: Returns an object's current shield value.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Object::GetCurrentShield: Bullet -> type shield damage; Missile -> type strength; Shield -> strength * charge/1000.0 (charge is a 16.16 per-mille share); Planet/Sun -> 10000000; asteroids etc. by class rule; containers (ships, stations) -> sum over installed Shield children. Sync.
notes: Container branch of GetCurrentShield not read to the end.

name: SA_GetMaxShield
summary: Returns an object's total shield capacity.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Object::GetShieldCapacity: Bullet -> type shield damage; Missile -> type strength; Shield -> type strength; Planet/Sun -> 10000000; Asteroid/Debris/wrecks -> 0; Special -> 100 or 0 by subtype; containers (ships, stations) -> sum of the strengths of their installed Shield children. Sync.

name: SA_SetShield
summary: Sets the total shield charge of an object, spread over its installed shields.
semantics: obj found -> Object::SetShieldCharge: only for class Ship, Space, Warpgate or an object with flag GateBypass (stations); else answer 0. capacity = obj's shield capacity (sum of installed shields, SA_GetMaxShield); capacity 0 -> answer 0. value > capacity -> capacity (negative is not clamped). Each installed Shield child gets charge = value*0x3e80000/capacity (per-mille share as 16.16). Answer = the stored value (after the upper clamp). Missing object -> 0.

name: SA_SetMaxAvoidShield
summary: Sets a ship's shield threshold used by collision-avoidance/flee logic.
semantics: Object found and class Ship -> ShipData.maxAvoidShield = arg2, answer arg2; otherwise answer 0, nothing written. The field is consulted by the ship AI (avoid behaviour). Answers at once.
notes: Consumer of the field not traced.

name: SA_GetLaser
summary: Returns an object's laser energy (ships: stored energy / 1000).
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. argc > 1: Ship::GetLaserEnergy -> ships: ShipData.laserEnergy / 1000, other classes 0 (arg1's value is not read, only its presence). argc == 1: Object::GetLaserEnergy -> Bullet: shield damage of the type; Missile: type strength; Ship: laserEnergy / 1000; others 0. Sync.
notes: FL has no call to Ship::GetLaserEnergy (inlined); branch structure not compared.

name: SA_GetMaxLaser
summary: Returns an object's maximum laser energy (ship type's laser energy capacity).
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. argc > 1: Ship::GetMaxLaserEnergy -> ships: type maxLaserEnergy, others 0. argc == 1: Object::GetMaxLaserEnergy -> Bullet: type shield damage; Missile: type strength; Ship: type maxLaserEnergy; others 0. Sync.

name: SA_GetLaserPosition
returns: int: gun slot index of the laser object
summary: Returns the gun slot a mounted laser object occupies.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns LaserData.slot. Original: no class check, so for a non-laser object the same payload word of that class is read. Sync.
bugs: AP 0x004624b8 (B113): payload read for any class (garbage / read past a small payload); fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_SetLaser
summary: Sets the laser energy of a ship (clamped to its maximum).
semantics: argc > 2: object must be class Ship (else 0): Ship::SetLaserEnergy: value = min(arg2, Object::GetMaxLaserEnergy(ship)) (no lower clamp), ShipData.laserEnergy = value*1000, answer value; arg3 is not read (only the count matters). argc <= 2: object found -> Object::SetLaserEnergy: only for class Ship, Space, Warpgate or flag GateBypass (else 0): same clamp and store, answer value. Missing object -> 0. Answers at once.
x3_src: differs: B112 - in the 2-argument form the store is done only for ships (answer unchanged)
bugs: AP Object::SetLaserEnergy 0x0044f110 (2-argument form): writes ShipData::laserEnergy (+0x2b4) for Space, gates and GateBypass objects too - 4 bytes past their payload. Fixed in x3_src (B112).
notes: FL inlines Ship::SetLaserEnergy (FL 0x0046db49).

name: SA_GetHull
summary: Returns an object's current hull value.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns Object.hull (any class). Sync.

name: SA_GetMaxHull
summary: Returns an object's maximum hull value.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Object::GetMaxHull: NoHull flag -> 0; a missile not yet launched (ware) -> tuning maxHullContainer; else the type's max hull (GetTypeMaxHull(class, subtype)). Sync.

name: SA_SetHull
summary: Sets the object's hull, clamped to 0..type maximum.
semantics: obj found -> Object::SetHull: max = 0 if the object has flag NoHull; for a Missile not yet launched max = the global MaxHullContainer parameter; else max = GetTypeMaxHull(class, subtype). hull = clamp(value, 0, max); answer = the stored hull. Setting 0 does not destroy the object (use SA_KillObject). Missing object -> 0.

name: SA_GetStrength
summary: Returns current shield charge plus current laser energy of the object.
semantics: obj found -> Object::GetCurrentShield(obj) + Object::GetLaserEnergy(obj) (the current values, not maxima); missing object -> 0. Used as a combat strength estimate. Answers at once.
notes: FL inlines Object::GetStrength (calls GetCurrentShield and GetLaserEnergy directly).

name: SA_GetNumCockpits
summary: Returns how many cockpits (view points / turrets with a view) a ship has.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Ship::GetTypeCockpitCount: non-Ship -> 0, else shipRows[subtype].viewPointCount. Sync.
notes: B119 (x3_src) prevents an out-of-table subtype being stored by SA_SetSubType, which this native would read.

name: SA_MoveObjectIntoContainer
summary: Moves an object into another object's container lists (cargo, hangar contents).
semantics: Both found -> answer = container.MoveObjectIntoContainer(obj) (Sector::MoveObjectIntoContainer: unlinks obj from its current parent's lists and links it into container's per-class list, parent = container; the object leaves space if it was in a sector). Missing either -> 0. Answers at once.
notes: Return value meaning (1 = moved) not verified.

name: SA_MoveLaserIntoContainer
summary: Moves a laser object into a ship and installs it in a gun slot.
semantics: laser and ship found and laser is class Laser -> moved = ship.MoveObjectIntoContainer(laser) (relinks the laser into the ship's laser list); the task is answered with moved; then LaserData.slot = (int16)slot and Ship::SetGunNodeEnabled(slot, ship, 1) shows the gun model in that slot. Otherwise 0. No check that slot is valid for the ship type or the laser compatible (see SA_GetShipTypeTurretLaserMask). Answers at once.
notes: The slot is written even when moved == 0.

name: SA_FindObjectTypeInContainer
returns: int: id of the next child of that class, 0 if none
summary: Iterates the children of a container (sector, ship, station) of a given class.
semantics: container by id; class = uint16(arg1). previous = arg2 by id when argc >= 3 and arg2 true, else start of list. Object::NextChildOfClass(previous, class): the next object of that class in the container's per-class child list (objects inside a sector, wares/lasers/shields inside a ship...). None -> 0. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B122 (unknown container or class >= 32 answers 0)
bugs: AP 0x0046250c (B122): container not NULL-checked; class not bounded to the 32 child lists; fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_FindObjectSubTypeInContainer
returns: int: id of the next child of that class and subtype, 0 if none
summary: Iterates the children of a container of a given class and subtype.
semantics: container by id; class = uint16(arg1), subtype = int16(arg2). previous = arg3 by id when argc >= 4 and arg3 true (an unknown previous id starts from the beginning). Object::NextChildOfClassAndType(previous, subtype, container, class): next object in the container's child list for that class after previous with that subtype. None -> 0. Typical loop: x = SA_FindObjectSubTypeInContainer(c, cls, sub); while (x) { ...; x = SA_FindObjectSubTypeInContainer(c, cls, sub, x); }. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B122 (unknown container or class >= 32 answers 0)
bugs: AP 0x0046256f (B122): container not NULL-checked (crash on unknown id); class indexes lists[(int16)cls] without 0..31 check (wild list head); fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_FindObjectByPathSerial
returns: int: id of the next child placed by that cut part index, 0 if none
summary: Finds the next child object of a parent that was placed by a given cut part (segment) index.
semantics: parent by id; previous = arg2 by id when argc >= 3 and arg2 true, else none. Sector::FindObjectByNodeSegmentIndex (findObjectByClipIndex)(previous, parent, arg1): next child whose placement segment index equals arg1. Not found -> 0. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B123 (unknown or non-container parent answers 0)
bugs: AP 0x00462613 (B123): parent not checked (NULL dereference for an unknown id); fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_FindObjectByPathBody
returns: int: id of the next child placed by a cut part with that body, 0 if none
summary: Finds the next child object of a parent whose cut-scene placement used a given body id.
semantics: parent by id; previous = arg2 by id when argc >= 3 and arg2 is true (CellIsTrue), else start from the beginning. Sector::FindObjectByCutBody(previous, parent, body): walks the parent's child object lists after 'previous' and returns the first object whose cut/segment record matches the body id (segment field +0x30). Not found -> 0. Iterate by passing the last result as previous. Sync.
x3_src: differs: B123 (unknown parent or a non-container parent answers 0)
bugs: AP 0x00462673 (B123): parent not checked: unknown id dereferences NULL, a non-container's payload is walked as child lists; fixed in x3_src.

name: SA_FindObjectByPathClass
returns: int: id of the next child with that cut mode, 0 if none
summary: Finds the next child object of a parent whose cut-scene placement record has a given mode/class value.
semantics: parent by id (missing -> 0). previous = arg2 by id when argc >= 3 and arg2 is true. Sector::FindObjectBySegmentField38 (x3_src findObjectByCutMode)(previous, parent, arg1): next child after previous whose placement segment field +0x38 equals arg1. Not found -> 0. Sync.

name: SA_SetFlags
summary: Overwrites the object's main flag word (the word SA_GetFlags returns).
semantics: obj found -> obj.flags = arg2 (the whole 32-bit word, no masking), answer arg2; missing -> 0. Scripts must read-modify-write (SA_GetFlags | bit). Bits include Destroyed, CollisionObject, ManualControl, AutopilotActive, GateBypass, NoHull and others; setting engine-owned bits can make later natives treat the object as another kind (e.g. GateBypass makes code read station data, see B115/B121/B127). Answers at once.

name: SA_GetFlags
summary: Returns an object's main flag word.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns the full Object.flags word (Destroyed, CollisionObject, GateBypass, ExternallyMoved, NoHull, player object, ... bits; written with SA_SetFlags). Sync.

name: SA_SetFlags2
summary: Overwrites the object's second flag word (SA_GetFlags2).
semantics: obj found -> obj.flags2 = arg2 (whole word), answer arg2; missing -> 0. flags2 holds DetailSwitch, CueForcedVisible and other render/cut bits. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetFlags2
summary: Returns an object's second flag word.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns Object.flags2 (Docked, DetailShown, carried 0x200000, ... bits; written with SA_SetFlags2). Sync.

name: SA_SetRenderLast
summary: Marks the object's root scene node to be drawn last.
semantics: obj found -> rootNode.flags2 |= 0x10 (render-last bit). One-way: there is no native to clear it. Answers 0.
x3_src: differs: B126 - an object without a scene node (sector) is ignored
bugs: AP 0x0046385d: rootNode not tested, a sector id writes near address 0 (crash). Fixed in x3_src (B126).

name: SA_GetCourseType
summary: Returns a ship's current flight order (course type) code.
semantics: ship by id, must be class Ship else 0. Returns (int16) ShipData.order: 0 stopped, 4 fly before container, 5 fly into container, 6 turn to, 8 warp away, 10 hold, 0x10/0x11 attack, 0x12 avoid, 0x14 escort, 0x15 follow, 0x16 follow by cut, 0x18 capture, 0x1b player landing, 0x1d idle, 0x1e leave hangar, 0x1f rotate to angles, 0x20 glide, 0x21 warp in, 0x22 defensive move, 0x23 move pos continue, 0x24 collect debris (codes as set by the order natives). Sync.

name: SA_GetEnvironment
returns: int: id of the object's parent (sector or container), 0 if none
summary: Returns the id of the object's parent (the sector it is in, or the ship/station carrying it).
semantics: object by id; missing or parent NULL (unplaced) -> 0. Else parent->id. A sector id returned here has no root node: many SA_ getters crashed on it in the original (B126). Sync.

name: SA_GetDestination
returns: int: id of the destination/target object, 0 if none
summary: Returns the current target object of a ship's order, a missile or a camera.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Ship -> ShipData.orderTarget; Missile -> MissileData.target; Camera -> CameraFollowData.target; other classes -> 0. NULL target -> 0. Sync.

name: SA_IsEnemy
summary: Tells whether b is hostile to a (Relation::IsHostile).
semantics: Both found -> Relation::IsHostile(b, a) non-zero -> 1, else 0 (uses the enemy-of flag, friend/enemy race masks, owner races). Missing either -> 0. Answers at once.
notes: Argument order to IsHostile (b, a) from x3_src; IsHostile rules not read.

name: SA_GetRelation
summary: Returns how one object (subject) stands towards another: hostile -1, neutral 0, friendly 1.
semantics: Both by id; either missing -> 0. Relation::GetRelation(other=arg1, subject=arg0): if the subject has a hostile override (PortContainerData.hostileOverride on ships/docks/factories) and its reverse stance towards other is hostile -> -1; else GetStance(other, subject): a flagged hostile missile from another launcher and race -> -1; otherwise from the race relation masks of the owner races (unless the subject ignores race relations, flags2) and per-object relation overrides. Sync.
notes: Stance rules inside GetStance only partly read.

name: SA_SetRelation
summary: Sets obj's friend/enemy bits for the race of other (by stance sign).
semantics: Both objects found -> Relation::SetRaceStanceBits(race = other.ownerRace (int16), obj, stance = arg4 - the FOURTH argument; arg3 is not read). Only for obj of class Dock(5), Factory(6) or Ship(7) and race >= 0: bit = 1<<race in obj's friend mask (data+0x1cc) and enemy mask (data+0x1d0): stance > 0, or race == obj's own race -> friend set, enemy cleared; stance < 0 -> friend cleared, enemy set; stance 0 -> both cleared (neutral). Other classes: nothing. Answers 0.

name: SA_SetGroupRelation
summary: Sets obj's friend/enemy bits for a race number.
semantics: obj found -> Relation::SetRaceStanceBits(race = arg2, obj, stance = arg3); same rules as SA_SetRelation (classes 5/6/7 only, race >= 0; stance >0 friend, <0 enemy, 0 neutral; own race is always friend). Race is used as a shift count (&31). Answers 0.

name: SA_SetGroup
summary: Sets the owner race (group) of an object.
semantics: obj found -> Object::SetGroup((int16)race): ownerRace = race. race == 10 (player): a Factory gets the player logo parts applied (Station::ApplyPlayerLogoParts) and node flag 0x40 is cleared on the whole scene subtree; any other race: flag 0x40 is set on the subtree. Does not change friend/enemy masks (SA_SetRelation / SA_SetGroupRelation) nor any race statistics. SA_GetGroup reads it back. Answers 0.

name: SA_GetGroup
summary: Returns the race/group (owner) of an object.
semantics: object by id; missing -> 0. Returns Object.ownerRace (the relation group set by SA_SetGroup; used by SA_GetRelation). Sync.

name: SA_TypeCreatesDebris
summary: Tells whether destroying a type leaves a debris field.
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Object::TypeCreatesDebris: only Asteroid and Debris classes; their debris map cut id must be non-zero and >= 0, the type's destroy effect must contain a debris element, and the cut must load (Scene::EnsureCutLoaded) -> 1; else 0. Answers at once.

name: SA_SetDebrisDensity
summary: Sets the rock density of a debris field object.
semantics: Object found and class Debris -> Object::SetClass1CValue: density < 0 -> 0; stores it in the debris payload's first dword and answers it. Non-debris or missing -> 0. Read back by SA_GetDebrisDensity. Answers at once.
notes: FL inlines the store.

name: SA_GetDebrisDensity
returns: int: density word of the debris object
summary: Returns the density value of a debris field object.
semantics: object by id, must be class Debris else 0. Returns the first word of its payload (the density set at creation / by SA_SetDebrisDensity). Sync.

name: SA_GetTypeWreckType
summary: Returns the wreck type key that a dock/factory/ship type turns into.
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Object::GetTypeWreckType: Dock -> class 29, Factory -> 30, Ship -> 31 (other classes -> 0); the wreck subtype is the same index, valid only if < the wreck class's count (else 0). Answer = (wreckClass << 16) | subtype. Answers at once.

name: SA_TypeCreatesWreck
summary: Tells whether destroying a dock/factory/ship type leaves a wreck.
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Object::TypeCreatesWreck: wreck class 29/30/31 for Dock/Factory/Ship (else 0); subtype must exist in the wreck class; its bodyId must be non-zero (AP: and >= 0), the destroy effect must contain a wreck element, and the body must be available -> 1; else 0. Answers at once.
fl: differs: FL has no sign check on the wreck body id (a negative id goes to Mesh::IsBodyAvailable); only matters for negative body ids in the data

name: SA_SetWreckDensity
summary: Sets the density value of a wreck object.
semantics: Object found and a wreck class (29/30/31) -> negative clamped to 0, stored in the payload's first dword, answer the stored value; otherwise 0. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetWreckDensity
summary: Returns the density value of a wreck object.
semantics: Object found and class DockWreck(29), FactoryWreck(30) or ShipWreck(31) -> the payload's first dword; otherwise 0. Answers at once.

name: SA_IsCollectible
summary: Tells whether an object can be collected (Ship::IsExpendable).
semantics: obj found and Ship::IsExpendable(obj) true -> 1, else 0 (wares, containers and other pick-up objects are collectible). Answers at once.
notes: IsExpendable criteria not re-read.

name: SA_SetHueModifier
summary: Sets the hue shift (degrees) of an object's model.
semantics: value = 360 - arg2. If the object is a Ship the value is stored (ShipData.storedHueDegrees; SA_GetHueModifier returns 360 - stored = arg2). If the object has a scene node, every node of the subtree gets the hue value through the render manager callback. Missing object: nothing. Answers 0.

name: SA_GetHueModifier
summary: Returns a ship's hue modifier in degrees.
semantics: object by id, must be class Ship else 0. Returns 360 - ShipData.storedHueDegrees (the setter stores the complement). Sync.

name: SA_SetSaturationModifier
summary: Sets the colour saturation factor (16.16) of an object's model.
semantics: Ship: ShipData.saturationModifier = arg2 (16.16, read back by SA_GetSaturationModifier). Any object with a scene node: every node of the subtree gets arg2 through the saturation callback. Missing object: nothing. Answers 0.

name: SA_GetSaturationModifier
summary: Returns a ship's colour saturation modifier.
semantics: object by id, must be class Ship else 0. Returns ShipData.saturationModifier (script units; set by SA_SetSaturationModifier). Sync.

name: SA_SetFactoryConnectionParent
summary: Sets the factory a station is connected to (complex hub link).
semantics: parent = FindByIdInWorld(arg2) if arg2 non-zero else NULL. Object found and class Factory -> StationData.targetRef = parent (raw pointer; clears with 0). Used by complex building (SA_CreateFactoryConnections). Otherwise nothing. Answers 0.

name: SA_SetNebulaProperties
args: nebula:id, radius:int, p0:int, p1:int, p2:int, p3:int, p4:int, parts:array[8], p8:int, scanocclusion:int
summary: Sets the parameters of a nebula object.
semantics: Object found and class Nebula -> NebulaData: radius = arg2, parameters[0..4] = arg3..arg7, parts[0..7] = arg8[0..7], parameter8 = arg9, scannerOcclusion = arg10 (how much the nebula reduces scanner range). Otherwise nothing. Answers 0.
x3_src: differs: B124 - arg8 must be an array of >= 8 elements, else nothing is written
bugs: AP 0x00467592: arg8 elements dereferenced unchecked - crash for a non-array/short array. Fixed in x3_src (B124).
notes: Meaning of parameters[0..4] and parameter8 (colours, fog densities) not established.

name: SA_SetPlanetFogParameter
summary: Sets a planet's fog (atmosphere) parameter.
semantics: Object found and class Planet -> PlanetData.fogParameter = arg2; otherwise nothing. Answers 0.

name: SA_SetShipRotAccel
summary: Sets a ship's rotation acceleration factor in percent.
semantics: Object found and class Ship -> ShipData.rotAccelFactor = arg2 percent as 16.16 (arg2*65536/100). SA_GetShipRotAccel returns it rounded back to percent. Non-ship/missing: nothing. Answers 0.

name: SA_GetShipRotAccel
returns: int: rotation acceleration factor in percent
summary: Returns a ship's rotation acceleration factor as a percentage.
semantics: object by id, must be class Ship else 0. Returns FixedMul16(ShipData+0x2b0 rotAccelFactor (16.16), 100) = rounded percent (100 = 1.0). Sync.
notes: FL 0x0047220a inlines the multiply with +0x8000 rounding.

name: SA_GetGlobalParameter
returns: int: the global parameter's value or the default
summary: Returns an engine global parameter (Globals) by id, or a default when it is not defined.
semantics: Script::GetGlobal(arg0, arg1): the first matching (id, value) pair of the loaded global parameters; no match -> arg1. Ids are those listed by SA_GetGlobalParameterNames. Sync.

name: SA_GetGlobalParameterNames
summary: Returns a table mapping every global parameter name to its id.
semantics: A new table; for each entry of the engine's global parameter name list (until the empty name) key = name string, value = id int (TableInsertAndGrow). The task gets the table. Sync.
notes: x3_src has an alternative builder (globalParameterLayout) producing the same pairs.

name: SA_ReloadGlobalParameters
summary: Reloads the global parameters table (Globals) from the data files.
semantics: Calls Init::LoadGlobalsTable() and answers its result (success flag). The values read by SA_GetGlobalParameter change at once. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetNumSubTypes
returns: int: number of types (subtypes) of the class
summary: Returns how many types (rows of the type file) a class has.
semantics: arg0 unsigned > 31 -> 0, else the loaded type count of that class (g_TypeCounts[class]). Sync.

name: SA_GetTypeCodeByName
summary: Finds a type by its id string (e.g. SS_SH_P_M3) and returns class<<16|subtype.
semantics: arg1 via CellGetString; not a string -> 0. Object::FindTypeIndexByName: if the first char is not a digit, searches all 32 classes in order, every row's id string (header+0x40), case sensitive strcmp; first match -> (class<<16)|index; no match -> 0. If the first char is a digit: atol(name) is returned as a ready type key when its class byte (bits 16..23) < 32 and its low 16 bits < count of that class, else 0. 0 is ambiguous with class 0 subtype 0. Answers at once.
notes: FL 0x004436e0 is the same function (unnamed in the FL database).

name: SA_GetSubTypeByName
summary: Finds a type's index within one class by its id string.
semantics: class > 31 (unsigned) -> 0. arg2 not a string -> 0. Object::FindTypeIndexByNameInCategory(class, name): if name starts with a digit, atol(name) when 0 <= value < count, else not found; otherwise strcmp against every row id string of that class, first match -> its index. Not found -> 0 in AP (ambiguous with subtype 0). Answers at once.
fl: differs: FL's FindTypeIndexByNameInCategory (0x004437a0) answers -1 for not found (and for a bad digit string); the handler's own class > 31 and non-string early exits still answer 0
notes: FL helper 0x004437a0 decompiled: -1 for not found, for a negative or too large digit string, and for class > 31.

name: SA_GetGTypeCodeByName
returns: int: type constant value, 0 if unknown
summary: Resolves a named type/subtype constant (e.g. a ship subtype enum name) to its value.
semantics: arg0 via CellGetString; not a string -> 0. Object::LookupTypeConstantByName: case-insensitive search through the engine's subtype name tables (ships, docks, factories, lasers, missiles, ... for each class) and returns the matching constant; not found -> 0. Sync.
notes: Exact composition of the returned value (plain subtype or class-tagged) not read.

name: SA_GetTypeGSubType
summary: Returns the general subtype code of a type (ship class code, weapon compatibility bit, or the row's subtype id).
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Else by class: Ship -> the ship class code (OBJ_SHIP_M1.. / TS etc. as in TShips); Laser and Missile -> the type's compatibility mask bit (the bit ships' turret/missile masks are tested against); any other class -> the row's subtypeId field. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetTypeSubTypeName
summary: Returns the id string of a type (e.g. SS_SH_P_M3).
semantics: Invalid type, or the row has no id string -> int 0. Else a new string cell with a copy of the row's id string (header+0x40) is answered (the temporary cell is destroyed after the resume). Inverse of SA_GetSubTypeByName / SA_GetTypeCodeByName. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetTypeMaxSpeed
summary: Returns the base max speed of a type (no ship tuning applied).
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Else Object::GetBaseMaxSpeed((int16)class, (int16)subtype): the type table's base speed (raw speed units; for ships the TShips speed without engine tunings, see SA_GetMaxSpeed for a live object). Answers at once.

name: SA_GetTypeAcceleration
summary: Returns the base acceleration of a type.
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Else Object::GetBaseAcceleration((int16)class, (int16)subtype) (type table value, no tuning). Answers at once.

name: SA_GetTypeMaxHull
summary: Returns the maximum hull of a type (class, subtype).
semantics: Object::IsValidTypeIndex(class, subtype) false -> 0. Else Object::GetTypeMaxHull((int16)class, (int16)subtype): the type table's hull value. Answers at once.
notes: bugs.md section 1 lists GetTypeMaxHull among the 64/32 divisions the restoration does not repeat (inside the helper, not the handler).

name: SA_GetTypeStepX
summary: Returns the type's first rotation rate cap (angle steps per second).
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Else the type header field x3_src calls yawRateCap (header (int16)class, (int16)subtype). For ships this is the TShips rate without tunings; SA_GetStepX of a live ship applies the bonus (and names it pitch). Answers at once.
notes: Axis naming is inconsistent between the x3_src header (yaw for StepX) and Ship::GetPitchRate (pitch for SA_GetStepX); not resolved.

name: SA_GetTypeStepY
summary: Returns the type's second rotation rate cap.
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Else the header field x3_src calls pitchRateCap. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetTypeStepZ
summary: Returns the type's roll rate cap.
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Else the header field rollRateCap. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetTypeTextID
summary: Returns the name text id of a type.
semantics: IsValidTypeIndex(class, subtype) (class < 32 unsigned, 0 <= subtype < count) false -> 0. Else the type header's nameTextId (the t-file id of the type name, page 17 in stock data). Answers at once.
notes: FL uses an inlined copy of IsValidTypeIndex (FUN_0046a610), same test. The same holds for every SA_GetType* native below.

name: SA_GetTypeBody
summary: Returns the main body (model) id of a type.
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Else the type header's bodyId (the model a new object of that type gets, see SA_SetSubType). Answers at once.

name: SA_GetTypeCompBody
summary: Returns the secondary (composite) body id of a type.
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Else the type header's bodyId2 (0 when the type has none; SA_GetCompBody falls back to the object's node body then). Answers at once.

name: SA_GetTypeCut
summary: Returns the cut (scene/animation) id of a type.
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Else Object::GetTypeKeyValue((int16)class, (int16)subtype): the type's scene/cut id (> 0 when the type has a cut scene file; becomes the object's sceneId). Answers at once.

name: SA_GetTypeVideoID
summary: Returns the video (comm portrait/encyclopedia video) id of a type.
semantics: Invalid type -> 0. Else the type header's videoId. Answers at once.

name: SA_GetShipTypeMaxExtraSpeed
summary: Returns how many speed (engine tuning) upgrades a ship type can take.
semantics: arg0 outside the Ship table -> 0, else shipRows[arg0].speedUpgradeLimit. Sync.

name: SA_GetShipTypeMaxExtraRotSpeed
summary: Returns how many rotation (steering) upgrades a ship type can take.
semantics: arg0 outside the Ship table -> 0, else shipRows[arg0].rotationUpgradeLimit. Sync.

name: SA_GetShipTypeCockpitBody
summary: Returns the cockpit scene (body) id of a ship type.
semantics: arg0 outside the Ship table -> 0, else shipRows[arg0].cockpitSceneId. Sync.

name: SA_GetShipTypeMaxShieldType
summary: Returns the largest shield type a ship type can mount.
semantics: arg0 outside the Ship table -> 0, else shipRows[arg0].maxShieldType. Sync.

name: SA_GetShipTypeMaxNumShields
summary: Returns how many shields a ship type can mount.
semantics: arg0 outside the Ship table -> 0, else shipRows[arg0].maxShieldCount. Sync.

name: SA_GetShipTypeMaxMissileType
returns: int: highest missile type index (legacy column)
summary: Returns a ship type's maximum missile type column.
semantics: arg0 outside the Ship table -> 0, else shipRows[arg0].missileMaxIndex. Modern compatibility uses the missile mask (SA_GetShipTypeMissileMask / SA_CanShipTypeInstallMissileType). Sync.

name: SA_GetShipTypeMaxNumMissiles
summary: Returns how many missiles a ship type can carry.
semantics: arg0 outside the Ship table -> 0, else shipRows[arg0].maxMissileCount. Sync.

name: SA_GetShipTypeTradeContainerSize
summary: Returns a ship type's minimum cargo bay volume.
semantics: arg0 outside the Ship table (< 0 or >= the TShips count) -> 0, else the ship type row's minimum cargo volume (TShips row +0x9c; SA_GetShipTypeMaxTradeContainerSize reads +0xa0). Sync.
notes: Missing from the reference pass; added at integration from AP 0x00464dc7 and x3_src saGetShipTypeTradeContainerSize (sa_dispatcher.cpp). FL handler not read beyond the case list (FL 0x0046f573 resumes with an int).

name: SA_GetShipTypeMaxTradeContainerSize
summary: Returns a ship type's base cargo bay volume.
semantics: arg0 outside the Ship table -> 0, else shipRows[arg0].maxCargoVolume. Sync.

name: SA_GetShipTypeMaxTKClass
summary: Returns the largest cargo size class (S/M/L/XL/ST) a ship type can carry.
semantics: arg0 outside the Ship table -> 0, else shipRows[arg0].maxCargoSize (transport class code). Sync.

name: SA_GetShipTypePredefinedWareCount
returns: int: number of occurrences of the ware in the type's predefined ware list
summary: Counts how often a ware appears in a ship type's predefined (built-in) ware list.
